segments.speaker: lead
segments.text: Morning everyone. Let us go round quickly. What did you work on yesterday and is anything blocking you?

segments.speaker: designer
segments.text: I finished the new sign up screens and shared them in the design channel. I am waiting on feedback from marketing.

segments.speaker: tester
segments.text: I tested the password reset flow. I found two bugs, one on mobile and one with expired links.

segments.speaker: designer
segments.text: Is the mobile one about the button being hidden behind the keyboard?

segments.speaker: tester
segments.text: Yes, exactly. It only happens on smaller phones.

segments.speaker: lead
segments.text: Can you two pair on that this morning? I would like both bugs fixed before the demo on Wednesday.

segments.speaker: lead
segments.text: Great. Last thing, please update your tickets before lunch so the board is accurate for the planning meeting.

segments.speaker: tester
segments.text: Will do. I will also add the steps to reproduce both bugs.

segments.speaker: designer
segments.text: And I will attach the updated screens to the sign up ticket.
